description: A commit is a stable point in project history. Branches point to commits. Parent commit IDs are ordered, with the first parent representing the mainline.

columns.name: parent_commit_ids
columns.description: Ordered parent commit IDs; position zero is the first parent and later positions are merge parents.

columns.name: base_commit_id
columns.description: Exact global commit composed underneath this commit. Null marks a base-native commit. This is state dependency, not ancestry.

columns.name: is_checkpoint
columns.description: Immutable membership in the repository checkpoint inventory.

columns.name: created_at
columns.description: Creation timestamp from immutable canonical commit metadata.
